subject: Sienna Health - marketplace commission split and term alignment
messages:
From: Emma Torres <emma@siennahealth.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-12-07T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Private offer question — commission split and billing term

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — Sienna is excited about Redwood's latency/cost story. Procurement asked me to get clarity on two items before we can proceed to a private offer: 1) can Redwood accept a 65/35 commission split (Sienna/Marketplace) for the first 12 months, and 2) our finance team needs Net60 invoice terms on the initial contract rather than Net30.

We want to list via AWS Private Offers and have a single-line PO. Can you confirm whether these terms are possible, and what approvals are required? Happy to share a redline.

Best,
Emma Torres
Head of Partnerships, Sienna Health
[Attachment: Sienna_RFP_Summary.pdf (pdf)]

From: jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-12-07T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Private offer question — commission split and billing term

Team — forwarding Sienna's request. Key asks: 65/35 commission split favoring Sienna for 12 months; Net60 on initial invoice.

Context: Sienna is a mid-market telehealth SaaS with a pilot starting Jan. They expect $120k ARR on Redwood usage in year 1, and listing on AWS marketplace helps their procurement plus simplifies billing for them.

I'm proposing: approve temporary commission carveout for first 12 months (65/35) with strict thresholds (min $80k ARR) and require finance to sign off on Net60 for the initial invoice only, with Net30 thereafter. This is nonstandard for us and will reduce take-rate materially; I think we should view it as a channel-structure decision that we can tolerate to win a strategic partner in telehealth.

Can you advise next steps and whether this needs exec signoff? If so, please escalate.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: proposed_commission_grid.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
To: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-12-07T13:47:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: Private offer question — commission split and billing term

Marissa — flagging for your approval.

Summary of ask from Jasmine (copied):
- Commission split 65/35 (Sienna/AWS marketplace payout structure) for 12 months starting at listing.
- Net60 initial invoice instead of our standard Net30.
- Require listing as AWS Private Offer; Sienna will manage marketplace listing paperwork.

Risk/notes:
- 65/35 materially reduces Redwood's revenue on marketplace-fulfilled sales for the first year; estimated revenue delta ~$36k on ARR projection provided.
- Precedent: we approved a short-term carveout last year for one enterprise partner but required minimum revenue threshold and a mandatory review at month 9.
- Finance impact: cashflow hit from Net60 — suggests requiring a modest upfront partial payment (20%) or invoice escrow. If leadership wants to avoid collection risk, consider conditioning Net60 on a 20% deposit via DocuSign.

Recommended approval path:
1) Sales/Deal Desk approves if min ARR >= $80k and 65/35 applies only to marketplace payout line for 12 months.
2) Finance to approve Net60 for initial invoice only, with 20% due on signature.
3) Exec (Marissa) signoff on commission carveout.

If you approve, I'll prepare a short memo for Marissa with proposed language and the DocuSign deposit step.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Deal Desk

From: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
To: jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-12-08T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: Private offer question — commission split and billing term

Jasmine / Karthik — I reviewed the numbers and agree we can approve with firm conditions. Approvals below: 

1) Commission split: APPROVED for 12 months at 65/35 (Sienna/Marketplace) provided the following are met:
   - Minimum committed ARR >= $80k (documented in private offer)
   - Quarterly usage review and opt-out clause for Redwood if usage drops below 50% of forecast in any quarter
   - This carveout applies only to the marketplace payout for the private offer and does not change our baseline direct-channel pricing.

2) Billing term: APPROVED Net60 on the first invoice only, subject to:
   - 20% deposit due on signature (DocuSign)
   - Subsequent invoices revert to Net30
   - Finance (Laura) to run credit for Sienna and sign off on any escrow requirement

3) Legal/Compliance: require Marketplace listing language vetted by Legal to ensure revenue recognition aligns with carveout period.

Please prepare: (a) DocuSign with deposit clause, (b) private offer draft with min ARR and opt-out language, (c) short approval memo to attach to the DocuSign record. Once those are attached I will countersign.

Marissa Cole
VP, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Sienna_PO_Template.pdf (pdf)]

Emma — great news: leadership has approved the request with conditions. Summary of approved path below and next steps.

Approved items:
- Commission split: 65/35 (Sienna/AWS marketplace payout) for 12 months, contingent on a minimum committed ARR of $80k. Quarterly usage reviews required; Redwood has opt-out if usage drops below 50% forecast in any quarter.
- Billing: Net60 only on first invoice, with a 20% deposit due at signature via DocuSign. Subsequent invoices will be Net30.

Action items for Sienna:
1) Please confirm acceptance of the above conditions in writing.
2) Sign the DocuSign deposit clause (link below) — DocuSign will generate the 20% deposit instruction and attach the private offer.
3) Send the finalized private offer paperwork for Redwood Legal review prior to listing.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/sienna-exec-approval-link
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/62345/DEAL-923

I'll attach the private offer template and commission grid for reference. Once we have your written confirmation and DocuSign deposit, Marissa will countersign and we can proceed to listing.

Thanks — excited to partner.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
